# Devlonic Solutions

> Devlonic Solutions is a remote web design and development studio that builds websites, online stores, apps and custom software for small businesses in the United States, with a focus on New Jersey, Texas and Florida. Every project has a fixed price agreed in writing before work starts. Founded and led by Muhammad Ahsan, a Top Rated developer on Upwork with 5+ years of experience.

## Key facts
- Contact: info@devlonics.com, +1 (201) 471-3717
- Service area: United States (remote), with dedicated local SEO research for New Jersey, Texas and Florida
- No physical office; projects run remotely with calls in the client's time zone
- Pricing: fixed quote per project, delivered in writing within one business day of a quote request
- Platforms: WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify, Laravel, Next.js
- Clients own their domain, hosting, content and code

## Services
- [Lead generation websites](https://devlonics.com/services/lead-generation-websites): Websites for contractors, home services, clinics and local businesses, built to turn visitors into calls, quote requests and bookings.
- [Small business websites](https://devlonics.com/services/small-business-websites): Custom-designed, mobile-first websites that are easy to edit and SEO-ready.
- [Online stores](https://devlonics.com/services/online-stores): Shopify and WooCommerce stores with Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay checkout, shipping and inventory setup.
- [Web and mobile apps](https://devlonics.com/services/app-development): iPhone, Android and web apps for bookings, memberships, ordering and customer accounts.
- [Custom software](https://devlonics.com/services/custom-software): CRMs, client portals, booking systems and dashboards built in Laravel and Next.js.
- [SEO and marketing](https://devlonics.com/services/seo-and-marketing): Local SEO, Google Business Profile, answer engine optimization (AEO) and paid ads on Google, Meta and TikTok.
